entries.headline: JenkinsPipelineUtils podYaml: a null resources quantity renders as the string "null", the case 033 B4 fixed for env
body: imageContainer() turns each resources quantity into quantity.toString() (vars/podYaml.groovy, the resources block), so [limits: [cpu: null]] renders `"cpu": "null"`. Kubernetes refuses the quantity only when the pod is created, not when podYaml evaluates the agent. P1 refused a null env value (033 B4) and left resources alone as outside its text. No file in the estate passes a null quantity today. Likewise a runAsUser that is not a number fails with Long.parseLong's NumberFormatException, which names no entry.
entries.consequence: A Jenkinsfile that passes a null quantity fails at pod creation with Kubernetes' quantity error instead of podYaml's message naming the entry; nothing does so today.
entries.author: code-writer, P1, r1, vars/podYaml.groovy imageContainer()

entries.headline: JenkinsPipelineUtils guide and P4's firmware files: a declarative agent on jenkins-agent-large without yamlMergeStrategy merge() drops that template's node affinity and toleration
body: The controller's jenkins-agent-large pod template is YAML only: a required nodeAffinity on homelab.local/performance=high and a toleration for that taint, Override, with inheritYamlMergeStrategy off. Only srvk8s4 carries the label and taint. Under the kubernetes plugin's default Override (4557.ve746270f672f: PodTemplateUtils.combine :484-486 and :511-513, Overrides.merge :20-24), a declarative agent that inherits it with its own podYaml YAML and no yamlMergeStrategy keeps only its own YAML. The build then lands on srvk8s1-3. The guide's POD-3 (docs/pages/guide/pod.md:32) names only kaniko as YAML only. docs/examples/firmware.groovy:15 and firmware-versions.groovy:14 inherit jenkins-agent-large without merge(), and so do P4's eight firmware files (e.g. /work/scratch/PaperClock/Jenkinsfile:14). The old scripted podTemplate had no YAML of its own, so the parent's was kept and the builds ran on srvk8s4. P5's four files with the same shape are review r1 F1, a fix-round item; this entry covers the rest.
entries.consequence: After the push, the eight ESP-IDF firmware builds run on the 3-CPU, 13 GiB nodes that carry prd workloads instead of the high-performance node, slower and competing with prd, with nothing saying so.

entries.headline: Jenkins MyDownloads/*, ScanToPdf/* and AaC twins: no build started after the push to main on the renamed repos
body: The four repos were renamed master→main and the eight jobs' branch spec changed to */main before the push. GitHub hook deliveries at 09:52:48–09:53:01 returned 200, and a redelivery at ~10:56 did too, but none of the eight jobs built (lastBuild predates the push). The jobs' BuildData only holds refs/remotes/origin/master, and /git/notifyCommit needs a token. Not hand-started: the plan allows one hand build. V11 not earned.
entries.consequence: Those eight jobs have never run their migrated file; the next push to those repos may be the first, and any fault in them shows then.
entries.author: test, r1, Jenkins API + GitHub deliveries

text: Cause witnessed, and the Consequence understates it: no future push starts these jobs either. Each job's GitHub Hook Log (`<job>/GitHubPollLog/`, read for MyDownloads/MyDownloadsClient, MyDownloads/MyDownloadsServer, ScanToPdf/ScanToPdfServer, AaC/ScanToPdfClient and AaC/MyDownloadsServer) shows the 10:57 redelivery's poll: `[poll] Last Built Revision: … (refs/remotes/origin/master)`, `git ls-remote -h` finds only `main` (MyDownloadsServer: main and three side branches), `No changes`. A Pipeline job polls with the SCMs its last successful build recorded, here the old file's `*/master` checkout, not the job's new `*/main` definition. `master` no longer exists on GitHub, so every hook poll finds nothing to build, whatever is pushed, until one build runs on `main` and records the new checkout. Each lastBuild is still the pre-rename build of 2026-10-01 ~13:17. The only starts that re-baseline them are by hand (Build Now, or `/git/notifyCommit` with `sha1=`), which the plan's Ordering constraints and V18 forbid beyond AaC/Architecture's one build.

Ruling R2 (operator, after consult 3's bail) now covers this. In its next round the test phase starts each of the eight jobs once by hand from main, after the P13/P14 push. Each build must finish SUCCESS, and V11 and V18 are read from those builds. The Ordering constraints, V18 and the plan's Not in scope list now name this second hand-start exception. No phase is owed. The entry resolves when the test phase reads those eight builds green; if one is red, it is a test-phase finding against the migrated file, not this defect.

entries.headline: P14's gate, kc project test in /work/scratch/ElectronicsInventory, cannot run in the Ansible environment: it has no s3storage or postgres service
body: ElectronicsInventory's `kc project test` runs `run-suite` for the backend and the frontend. Both suites need an S3 endpoint at `localhost:9000`, which ElectronicsInventory's own environment provides as its `s3storage` service. Its setup also needs `postgres` at `localhost:5432`. This environment (pvginkel-ansible-011d6a) has neither; `kc env describe` lists terraform-backend-git, iac, go, aac-tools, java, modern-app, python, frontend, document-conversion and image-builder. In this run the backend suite exits with `S3 storage is not reachable at http://localhost:9000`. The frontend's global setup fails in `initialize-sqlite-database.sh` with `Could not connect to the endpoint URL: "http://localhost:9000/..."`. `kc project setup` stops at `init-dev-database.py` (`connection to server at "127.0.0.1", port 5432 failed`). These failures do not depend on the change.

The suite was run instead in a Job in prd's `development` namespace. The Job uses the library's validation-Job manifest (`modernApp.jobManifest`): the same toolchain image, the rustfs service, the Jenkinsfile's S3 env and the same resources. It runs the same `poetry run run-suite --output-mode full --junitxml-dir /work/results --retries 2` on the committed tree. Results: backend 1137 passed, 0 failed; frontend 256 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped; no retries. `kc project lint --project frontend` is green here.
entries.consequence: The driver's re-run of P14's gate fails in this environment on 'S3 storage is not reachable at http://localhost:9000' whatever the change; the evidence that the change works is the development-namespace run and the push's build.
entries.author: executor, P14, r1, phases/P14/executor_result_r1.json
